# Runtime 0.1.11 image native dependencies

## Change and boundaries

The four platform packages require exact Bun 1.4.0, target sharp 0.34.5 and
target libvips package 1.2.4 dependencies. Staging, standalone prepack,
archive verification and install smoke share one dependency contract.
The Bun probe checks the actual core resolution anchor, package versions,
installation containment and native library loading. Optional overrides and
escaped files fail before success.

Original src bytes, SDK 0.2.145, CLI compatibility 2.1.241, session/resume,
cancel, permissions and Dream thread-local tmpdir remain unchanged.
Published 0.1.10 is never repacked. The operator authorized validation followed
by production publication and normal adoption; each stage requires its own evidence.

Private same-byte CLI fixtures from the earlier source-repair stage prove technical
behavior only. They do not qualify these new release archives or establish real-model
business acceptance.

The isolated-worktree unit run skipped seven fixture-dependent checks: sibling Dream
driver/Python, official comparator, OAuth pipe/PTY fixtures and production manifest
acceptance. The focused rerun supplied the existing explicit Dream root and Python,
passed management imports and provider-free candidate checks, and retained three skips:
two official comparator checks and production manifest acceptance pinned to 0.1.10.
The four-host
workflow supplies official SDK/MCP/OAuth fixtures, but its pinned Dream revision uses
Runtime 0.1.5; the production manifest acceptance test explicitly rejects a mismatched
candidate then skips. That test is not a production adoption receipt. Normal Dream
0.1.11 resolver/install acceptance must follow successful publication separately.
